api: Capsule CRM API v2 (https://api.capsulecrm.com/api/v2); provider artifact version: v2
scope: Exact existing-surface evidence fallback: the preserved source inventory contains 132 official-survey operation entries, exactly matching the immutable count. Shared executable bindings for the same provider method/path are merged into one normalized endpoint. The cited official html_reference artifact is retained as the v2 provenance root; no operation was inferred from a documentation crawl. Prior source-surface scope: Pass B full-surface expansion: every documented Capsule v2 endpoint is enumerated below, covered_by a stream/write action or excluded with a specific reason. Core CRM entities (parties, opportunities, kases/cases, tasks) now have full CRUD write coverage in addition to their existing read streams; account-configuration list endpoints (tags, custom field definitions, teams, pipelines, milestones, lost reasons, task categories, boards, stages) are new read streams. Detail/show-by-id endpoints are excluded as duplicate_of their list counterpart (the dialect has no per-id detail-stream primitive distinct from a list read); search/deleted/embed sub-endpoints, the ad hoc query filter, entries/history, tracks, webhooks, activity types, goals, and internationalization reference data are out of scope for this wave.
